image_description: A male Wood Duck (Aix sponsa) floating on calm water. The duck features distinctive iridescent green and purple head plumage with bold white stripes, a red eye, and a patterned body with chestnut, black, and cream feathers. A clear reflection of the duck is visible in the water below.
